admission.justification: D1000/D1001 chose full removal of CGC/GrepAI and routing leftovers through removed_stores and unusedSettingsKeys over keeping the L166/L192 half-retired safety loop, constraining future work not to restore provider safety loops or provider-specific cleanup/settings routes.

alternatives.option: Remove CodeGraphContext and GrepAI completely (package, dashboard _metrics_loop safety loop, providers-remove CLI, tool parameters, and active settings schemas), reporting pre-existing provider folders through removed_stores and tolerating legacy keys via unusedSettingsKeys.
alternatives.reason: Eliminates dead maintenance surface and unused runtime loops while preserving non-destructive upgrade visibility for older installations and backwards compatibility for stored settings and pre-removal cleanup archives.

alternatives.option: Keep the half-retired providers package, periodic _metrics_loop safety loop, and providers-remove command from L166/L192.
alternatives.reason: Retains unused code, background safety polling, and provider-specific CLI/tool/settings plumbing for two providers that have zero product use.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The developer directs introducing a new managed code-search provider with an active runtime owner.

consequences: Supersedes DEC-ZS4FH6; the dashboard no longer runs a periodic provider safety metrics loop.
Pre-existing installation provider directories are surfaced via removed_stores without automatic deletion, and legacy settings keys load unread into unusedSettingsKeys.
Future work must not restore CGC/GrepAI provider loops, provider-specific cleanup commands, or removed provider tool parameters without a new developer decision.
context: CodeGraphContext (CGC) and GrepAI were already half-retired with zero use, yet their 57-module package, dashboard _metrics_loop safety loop, install watcher stop, providers-remove CLI, tool parameters, and settings schemas remained in the product.
decider: Developer rulings D1000, D1001, and D1005 (2026-11-25), released as DEP-R02@v1.
